If Akiha sees me like this, mere worry will be the least of it—

No one came to visit, and something went wrong with my eyes.

Until I met the Magician, beautiful as a clear blue sky.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Shiki remembers meeting the beautiful 魔法使い. In Type-Moon's setting this term marks a practitioner of true Magic and is distinct from 魔術師, a mage or thaumaturge. 'Sorceress' collapses the load-bearing terminology into a generic fantasy label.

"…… Yes.
I do not understand why he went crazy at such a young age.
But he inverted without any warning.
When that happened, he attacked you, Nii-san."
"SHIKI…… attacked me……?"
Throb.
The old wound on my chest aches.

lines.japanese:
「その時の場所があの中庭なんです。
兄さんはシキに胸を貫かれて、もう瀕死の状態でした。
そこに父が駆けつけて、シキを止めたんです。
　……理性を失っていたシキを止めるには、息の根を止めるしかない。
　遠野家の当主には、そうやって反転してしまった一族の者を処理する義務があるんです。
　ですから―――兄さんが見た血まみれのシキというのは、父に処理されたあとのシキではないでしょうか」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“It happened in that courtyard. SHIKI pierced your chest and left you dying. Then Father arrived and stopped him.
There was only one way to stop SHIKI after he lost his reason: kill him.
The head of the Tohno family has a duty to dispose of any relative who undergoes Inversion.
So might the blood-soaked SHIKI you remember have been SHIKI after Father dealt with him?”
lines.mao_english:
“It happened in that courtyard. SHIKI pierced your chest and left you dying. Then Father arrived and stopped him.
There was only one way to stop SHIKI after he lost his reason: kill him.
The head of the Tohno family has a duty to dispose of any relative who undergoes Inversion.
So might the blood-soaked SHIKI you remember have been SHIKI after Father dealt with him?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"It happened in that courtyard.
You were stabbed in the chest and were on the verge of death when Father came and stopped SHIKI.
…… To stop SHIKI who has lost his mind, you can only kill him.
It is the duty of the head of the Tohno household to deal with members of the family who have inverted.
So----the bloody SHIKI you saw was probably the result of Father dealing with him."

lines.japanese:
「―――――――」
　よく、思い出せない。
　その時、もっと何か。
とても大切なコトがあった気がするのだけど、思い出せない。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
I cannot remember clearly.
Something else happened then. I feel it was terribly important, but I cannot remember.

I can't remember.

There was something else.
I feel like there was something more important that I can't remember.

lines.japanese:
「……そのあと、兄さんは奇跡的に一命を取り留めました。
あとは兄さんの記憶にあるとおり、遠野志貴は事故に巻き込まれた、という偽証をして病院に運ばれたんです」
「――――」
「……私が次女でありながら当主として育てられたのもそれが原因でした。
　一度でも“反転”した者を当主として迎えるわけにはいきませんから、シキは後継ぎではなくなって、唯一血を継いでいる私が後継ぎになったんです」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Afterward, you survived by a miracle. As you remember, they fabricated the story that Shiki Tohno had been caught in an accident and took you to the hospital.”
“…”
“That was also why I was raised to head the family despite being the younger daughter.
Someone who had undergone Inversion could never be accepted as head, so SHIKI lost his place as heir and I, the only remaining child of the bloodline, inherited it.”
lines.mao_english:
“Afterward, you survived by a miracle. As you remember, they fabricated the story that Shiki Tohno had been caught in an accident and took you to the hospital.”
“…”

Someone who had undergone Inversion could never be accepted as head, so SHIKI lost his place as heir and I, the only remaining child of the bloodline, inherited it.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Afterwards, you miraculously recovered.
And as you remember, you were taken to the hospital and told you were in a big accident."

"----"
"…… For that reason, I was then raised to be successor of the Tohno family even though I was the second child.
Once "inverted", SHIKI could no longer be the successor, so the only other remaining blood relative had to be chosen."

兄さん、こんな話を信じてくれるんですか……？」

lines.maoEnglish:
“Akiha. That doesn’t make sense. SHIKI was the one who underwent Inversion, wasn’t he?
Then does that mean I’m—not normal?”
“I’m surprised. You believe all this, Brother?”
“Listen. You would never invent a lie like this, and besides, I’ve had some experience with stories like these.
But never mind that! I’m asking why your explanation doesn’t add up, Akiha.”

おかしくありませんから、これ以上の事情は、聞かないわけにはいきませんか……？」
「―――ダメだ、秋葉。
　悪いけど、シキの話は俺にとって大事なものなんだ。
あいつは俺にとっても、アイツにとっても共通の敵だ。
無視することはできない。
　だから―――正体を知っておかないと。
そのためには疑問点なんて残しておけないんだ。
　どうして親父に殺されたハズのあいつが生きているのか、どうして―――俺が、そんな大事なことを忘れていたのか。
　頼む。
教えてくれ、秋葉」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“You’re right. But, Brother, there is no contradiction. Couldn’t you simply leave the rest unasked?”
“No, Akiha.
I’m sorry, but SHIKI matters too much. He is an enemy to both me and her. I can’t ignore him.
I need to know what he is. To do that, I can’t leave any questions unanswered.
Why is he alive if Father killed him, and why did I forget something so important?
Please. Tell me, Akiha.”

I can't have any traces of doubt left.
Why he is alive if the old man killed him, why----I forgot something so important.

Tell me, Akiha."

I wish that mirage could have lasted forever.”

「……兄さんと私、それにシキ。
私たちは本当の兄妹として育てられました。
　兄さんとシキはとても仲がよくて、わたしも幼心に嫉妬するぐらい、仲が良かった。
　けど、シキがあんなコトになってしまった時に全てが狂ったんです。
　シキは内々に処理したけれど、遠野家の長男を殺してしまうわけにはいかない。
　遠野家は社会的にも地位のある家柄でしょう？
　だから……簡単に後継ぎである長男が居なくなりました、なんて事は周りに報せられなかった」

lines.maoEnglish:
“You and SHIKI and I. We were raised as true siblings.
You and SHIKI were so close that even as a little girl, I was jealous.
But when that happened to SHIKI, everything went wrong.
He was dealt with in secret, but the eldest son of the Tohno family could not simply be allowed to die.
The Tohnos hold considerable social standing. They could hardly announce that their eldest son and heir had suddenly vanished.”

“You and SHIKI and I. We were raised as true siblings.

The Tohnos hold considerable social standing. They could hardly announce that their eldest son and heir had suddenly vanished.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… You and I, and SHIKI.
We were raised as true siblings.
You were really good friends with SHIKI, almost enough to make my childish heart feel jealous.
But, after what happened to SHIKI, everything went wrong.
SHIKI was taken care of secretly, but the eldest son of the Tohno household could not be killed.
The Tohno family has important standing in society, doesn't it?
So…… they could not tell society that the heir to the family suddenly just disappeared."

　シキに殺されかけた兄さんを本当の遠野志貴として扱い、反転して人間でなくなってしまったシキを事故で死亡してしまった養子として扱えばいい、と。
―――つまり、兄さんはシキと入れ替わったんです。
　殺された側が生き残って、殺した側が死んでしまった。
それが兄さんとシキの関係なんです」

lines.maoEnglish:
“Then Father had an idea.
He could pass you, whom SHIKI had nearly killed, off as the real Shiki Tohno—and declare that SHIKI, who had undergone Inversion and ceased to be human, was the adopted child killed in an accident.
―――In other words, he switched the two of you.
The victim survived, and the killer died. That is the relationship between you and SHIKI.”
lines.mao_english:
“Then Father had an idea.

―――In other words, he switched the two of you.
The victim survived, and the killer died. That is the relationship between you and SHIKI.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Then Father had an idea.
To treat Nii-san, who was almost killed by SHIKI, as Tohno Shiki and to let SHIKI be the adopted son who died in an accident.
----In other words, you traded places with SHIKI.
The one killed remained alive, and the one who killed, died.
That is your relationship with SHIKI."

When you replaced SHIKI Tohno eight years ago, Father disposed of it all.”

lines.maoEnglish:
“That is why you were sent to the Arima family.
For appearances, the Tohno family’s eldest son needed to remain alive.
But since you shared none of our blood, you could not inherit.
Father used the weakness left by your accident as an excuse to exile you to the Arimas. He ordered me never to let you set foot in the Tohno mansion again.”
Akiha’s voice trembles.
Her head is bowed, as though she is struggling to hold something back.
She must feel an enormous guilt toward me.

　世間体のために、とりあえず遠野家の長男は生きていなくてはいけない。
　けれど本当は血が繋がってはいないから、後継ぎにはさせられない。
　父は事故で体が弱っているという理由をつけて、兄さんを有間の家に追放したんです。
……二度と、遠野の家に立ち入らせないようにって私に言いつけて」
　………秋葉の声は、どこか震えている。
　俯いて、何かを堪えているような仕草をしている。
　……秋葉はきっと、俺に対してものすごい罪悪感を抱いている。
evidence.japaneseHighlight: 有間の家に預けられた
evidence.label: s199
evidence.mirrorMoon:
"That is why…… you were adopted by the Arima family.
To maintain appearances, the eldest son of the Tohno family must still be alive.
However, since you are not related by blood you cannot be the heir.
Reasoning that your body was weakened by the accident, you were given to the care of the Arima family.
…… He commanded me not to let you near the mansion again."
…… Akiha's voice is trembling.
She looks down, acting like she's resisting something.
…… I know she must feel terribly guilty.
evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: adopted by the Arima family.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Shiki was entrusted or sent to live with the Arima family while publicly remaining the Tohno eldest son. mirror moon says the Arimas adopted him, inventing a legal change incompatible with the Tohno identity Makihisa preserved for appearances.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: Placement with the Arima family becomes adoption by them

「まず一つ目。
　俺が遠野の人間じゃないのはわかった。
けど、それじゃ疑問点が出てきてしまうんだ。
　……遠野の人間は特別な人間だっていうけど。
実はさ、俺も少しだけおかしな体質をしてるんだ。
　先輩は俺が遠野家の人間だからそういう力があるって言ってて、俺もそれに納得した。
けど、俺は遠野家の人間じゃないんだろう？
　なら、これはどういうコトなんだろう」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“First.
I understand that I’m not a Tohno. But that creates another problem.
You say members of the Tohno family are different from ordinary people. The truth is, there’s something unusual about my body too.
Ciel thought I had that power because I was a Tohno, and I believed her. But I’m not one of you, am I?
Then what does that make me?”

「……わかりません。
たしかに父は気紛れで養子をとるような人ではありませんでしたから―――兄さんを養子にとったのも何かしら意味があっての事だったのかもしれません」
「そうか……まあ、このさい自分が何者かなんてコトは、本当にどうでもいいんだ。
だから秋葉もそんなに気にする必要はないぜ。
　その、さ。
俺、生きてるだけでラッキーだって思うんだ。
本当なら死んでいたような傷だったんだろ？
　ならこうしていられるだけで幸運だよ」
　そう。
そんなコトより、問題は――――
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“I don’t know. Father was not a man who adopted children on a whim, so perhaps he did have some purpose in taking you in.”
“I see. At this point, I honestly don’t care what I am, so you don’t need to worry about it either.
Look. I’m lucky simply to be alive. That wound should have killed me, shouldn’t it? Being here at all is good fortune enough.”
Yes. Compared with that, the real problem is—

　なら―――ああして生きているハズがない」

“That—I…”

「可能性があるとしたら一つだけだ。
俺が一命をとりとめたように、あいつも一命を取り留めた。
　……いや、もしかすると親父はシキの息の根を止めなかったのかもしれないな。
　だって、どんなに狂ってしまったっていっても血をわけた自分の息子なんだ。
だから殺さず、人目につかないところで養生させてたんじゃないのか。
俺が病院に担ぎ込まれたみたいにさ」

lines.maoEnglish:
“There’s only one possibility. I survived, and so did he.
Or perhaps Father never killed SHIKI at all.
However mad he became, SHIKI was still his own flesh and blood. Maybe Father spared him and let him recover somewhere out of sight. The same way they took me to a hospital.”
Akiha does not answer.
It seems my guess may not have been wrong.

　腕や足みたいな大きな部分を動かそうとするから動かないんだ。
　まずは凄く小さいところ。
　たとえば右手の小指を動かすことに神経を集中させる。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Haa…”
I take a long breath and calm myself.
Perhaps I cannot move because I keep trying to command large things like my arms and legs.
Start somewhere tiny.
I focus every nerve upon moving the little finger of my right hand.

lines.maoEnglish:

At last, my little finger twitches.

lines.japanese:
小指だけにしろ、体が動くという感覚は頼りになる。
　神経の感覚がどんなものかを思い出すように、小指から薬指、手の平、肘、腕、肩、と動く場所を増やしていく。
「はあ―――はあ――――はあ――――」
　動ける個所が増えれば増えるほど、痛みが多くともなってくる。
　なるほど―――痛みを感じなかったのは、ようするに全身が麻痺していたためか。
　こうやって少しずつ神経を取り戻していけば、同時に痛みも取り戻すというコトらしい。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
Even one moving finger gives me something to build upon.
Recalling what the touch of my own nerves feels like, I widen the territory I can move: little finger, ring finger, palm, elbow, arm, shoulder.
“Hah—hah—hah”
The more of my body I reclaim, the more pain returns with it.
Of course—I felt nothing because my entire body was numb.
As my nerves awaken one by one, they bring the pain back too.

I start to pant.
The more I can move, the more pain fills me.
I see----I didn't feel pain because my whole body was numb.
Restoring my nerves like this means pain returns at the same time.

lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Gah—ngh!”
Fighting down nausea, I force my upper body upright.
Walking may be the most I can manage, but that is enough.
Surviving after Roa struck the point in my chest is already a miracle. Asking for more would be tempting fate.
I examine the wound where the knife entered my chest.
―――And then.
There is nothing anywhere on my chest that resembles a Point of Death.

If I wished for any more luck, karma would probably punish me.
I look at the knife wound on my chest.
----And,
I don't see the point indicating death on my chest anywhere.

lines.maoEnglish:
“What…?”
A sudden clarity comes over me.
Anything stabbed through a Point of Death dies, no questions asked.
Even Nrvnqsr, that immortal monster, was no exception.
Someone like me could never survive such a wound.
“Maybe what he sees and what I see aren’t the same.”
The thought has barely formed.
A light knock sounds, and Ciel enters the room.

"----Maybe what he sees is different?"

a light knock sounds at my door and Senpai enters the room.

　つまり、まだアルクェイドはロアを見つけていない、というコトか。
　それなら――――まだ、あいつを掴まえるチャンスはある。

There is still a chance to reach her first.

In other words, Arcueid hasn't found him yet.
If so----then there's still a chance of me finding her.

lines.japanese:
「遠野くん？」
「あ―――いや、こっちの話。
けどさ、どうしてロアはうちの学校なんかを住み家にしてるんだ？
　
　……いや、そもそも。
アイツはロアっていうよりシキのような気がするんだ。
なんか吸血鬼っていう感じがまったくしなかった。
アレは、いったいどういうコトなんだろう」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Tohno?”
“Nothing. But why would Roa make our school his lair?
Actually—no. He felt more like SHIKI than Roa. I didn’t get any sense of a vampire from him. What exactly is going on?”

「どういうコトもなにも、カレの人格ソースはシキという人物ですから。
吸血鬼らしくない、というのも当然の話なんです」
「……？
　ちょっと待ってよ。
シキはロアってヤツの転生体なんだろ。
なら性格はロアなんだから、シキっていう人間の、人間らしさっていうのは無くなるんじゃないのか……？」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“His personality is built upon SHIKI’s. Naturally, he does not behave like a vampire.”
“Wait. SHIKI is Roa’s reincarnation vessel, isn’t he? Shouldn’t Roa’s personality replace his? Wouldn’t everything human about SHIKI disappear?”
lines.mao_english:
“His personality is built upon SHIKI’s. Naturally, he does not behave like a vampire.”
“Wait. SHIKI is Roa’s reincarnation vessel, isn’t he? Shouldn’t Roa’s personality replace his? Wouldn’t everything human about SHIKI disappear?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"It doesn't mean anything other than the source of his character is SHIKI.
Of course he doesn't act like a vampire."
"……?
Hold on, SHIKI is Roa's host, right?
Then his personality is Roa's, so wouldn't he start acting less like a human……?"
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「……いいえ、そんな事はありません。
　いいですか遠野くん。
ロアが転生先に選んだ肉体は、ロアとは別の人格・人間として育つんです。
ロアの意識が浮上するまで一個の人間として成長しなければ、せっかくのロアとしての知性を活用する事がてきないからです。
　ですからロアとして覚醒したあとも、その代のロアの行動原理はその時の転生先の肉体にそうものなんです」
「じゃあアイツは間違いなくシキで、ロアなんていう人格はまったくないっていう事なのか？」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“No, it doesn’t work that way.
Listen, Tohno. The body Roa chooses as his next host grows into a human being with a personality separate from Roa’s. Unless it first matures as an independent person, it cannot make use of the intellect Roa gives it when his consciousness surfaces.
Even after awakening as Roa, therefore, each incarnation acts according to the nature of its host body.”
“Then he truly is SHIKI, with no separate personality called Roa at all?”
lines.mao_english:
“No, it doesn’t work that way.
Listen, Tohno. The body Roa chooses as his next host grows into a human being with a personality separate from Roa’s. Unless it first matures as an independent person, it cannot make use of the intellect Roa gives it when his consciousness surfaces.
Even after awakening as Roa, therefore, each incarnation acts according to the nature of its host body.”
“Then he truly is SHIKI, with no separate personality called Roa at all?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… No, not at all.
Okay, Tohno-kun.
The body Roa reincarnated into is raised as a different person with a different character.
Unless he matures as a human until Roa awakens, he will not be able to use his intelligence as Roa.
But after Roa awoke within him, Roa's principles follow that of the host."
"Then that guy is unmistakably SHIKI, and there's none of Roa's personality at all?"
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「……はい。
ある意味、ロア、などという人物はもう存在しないんです。
あそこにいるのはただ永遠という事柄、不老不死を求める強迫観念にすぎません。
　厄介なのはその脅迫概念に意思と歴史、積み重ねた魔道の知識があるという事です。
　ロアとしては、ただ不老不死という命題さえ求め続けられるのなら、それ以外では自分が何をしようとかまわないんです。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“In one sense, yes. The man called Roa no longer exists. What remains is an obsession with eternity—a compulsion to attain ageless immortality.
The difficulty is that this compulsion possesses a will, a history, and centuries of accumulated magical knowledge.
As long as the pursuit of immortality continues, ‘Roa’ cares nothing about what else his current self may choose to do.
lines.mao_english:
“In one sense, yes. The man called Roa no longer exists. What remains is an obsession with eternity—a compulsion to attain ageless immortality.
The difficulty is that this compulsion possesses a will, a history, and centuries of accumulated magical knowledge.
As long as the pursuit of immortality continues, ‘Roa’ cares nothing about what else his current self may choose to do.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… Yes.
In a way, Roa doesn't exactly exist anymore.
What does exist is the conceptualization of Roa's desire for immortality.
What's troublesome is the steady accumulation of wills, of history, of magical knowledge, all parts of this malicious conceptualization.
For Roa, as long as he can continue his thesis on immortality, he doesn't care what else he does.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Ciel says the person Roa no longer exists; what remains is the matter of eternity, an obsessive compulsion toward immortality, made dangerous because that compulsion possesses will, history, and accumulated magical knowledge. mirror moon repeatedly substitutes 'conceptualization' and then redistributes those possessed qualities as a 'steady accumulation,' obscuring the ontology of the reincarnating drive.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: Roa's obsession with immortality becomes a conceptualization of desire

lines.japanese:
「ロアは死者たちを増やしていく。
けれどそれは『子供を増やす』という種としての本能と似たようなものなんです。
シキ本人の意思、カレのやりたいと思う事はそれとは別のものになります」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish: “Roa creates more of the Dead. But that resembles the instinct of a species to reproduce. SHIKI’s own wishes—the things he personally wants—are separate from that.”
lines.mao_english: “Roa creates more of the Dead. But that resembles the instinct of a species to reproduce. SHIKI’s own wishes—the things he personally wants—are separate from that.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Roa increases his Dead, but it's really more like a instinct in a species to 'breed children'.
SHIKI's true desire and what Roa really wants to do are completely different from each other.

「……シキ本人の、やりたい事……」
「はい。
おそらくカレの目的はアルクェイドを懐柔することより、遠野くん、貴方の殺害を第一としているはずです」
「――――――は？」
　先輩の結論は、俺には理解できそうにない。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“What SHIKI personally wants…”
“Yes. I believe that for him, killing you, Tohno, takes precedence even over winning Arcueid over.”
“What?”
Her conclusion makes no sense to me.
lines.mao_english:
“What SHIKI personally wants…”
“Yes. I believe that for him, killing you, Tohno, takes precedence even over winning Arcueid over.”

Her conclusion makes no sense to me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… What SHIKI… really wants to do……"
"Yes.
Probably, his desire to kill you is far greater than any conciliation with Arcueid."
"------Wha…?"
I don't get at all what she's trying to say.
lines.mirror_moon:

「シキの目的が俺の殺害って、どうして」
「……そうですね。
言いにくい事ですが、シキにとって貴方は自分を殺した人だからだと思います」
「なんだよそれ。
殺されたのはこっちのほうだ。
あべこべだよ、それ」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Why would SHIKI’s first goal be killing me?”
“This is difficult to say. I think it is because, to SHIKI, you are the person who killed him.”
“What is that supposed to mean? I’m the one he killed. That’s completely backward.”
lines.mao_english:
“Why would SHIKI’s first goal be killing me?”

“What is that supposed to mean? I’m the one he killed. That’s completely backward.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Why would he want to kill me?"
"…… Hmm, it's hard to say, but SHIKI thinks you killed him."
"What do you mean?
I'm the one who was killed, he's got it all backwards."
lines.mirror_moon:
"Why would he want to kill me?"

lines.japanese:
「でも遠野くんは生きている。
そしてシキは殺されてしまった。
その結果、貴方は遠野志貴になってしまったでしょう？
　シキは遠野の身内たちの手によって処罰されたあと、遠野くんのように奇跡的に蘇生しました。
　けれど、その後に自分の家に戻っても彼の居場所はなくなっていたんです。
　だって遠野志貴はきちんと生きていて、妹の秋葉さんと暮らしていたんですから」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“And yet you lived. SHIKI was killed. As a result, you became Shiki Tohno, didn’t you?
After the Tohno family dealt with him, SHIKI revived by a miracle much as you did.
But when he returned, he no longer had a place in his own home.
Shiki Tohno was alive and well, living there with his sister Akiha.”
lines.mao_english:
“And yet you lived. SHIKI was killed. As a result, you became Shiki Tohno, didn’t you?
After the Tohno family dealt with him, SHIKI revived by a miracle much as you did.
But when he returned, he no longer had a place in his own home.
Shiki Tohno was alive and well, living there with his sister Akiha.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"But you are alive, Tohno-kun, and SHIKI was killed.
In the end, you became Tohno Shiki, did you not?
After SHIKI received judgment from the Tohno family, he had a miraculous recovery just like yours.
However, he didn't have his house to return to.
Because Tohno Shiki was very much alive, living with his sister Akiha-san."
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「ある意味―――貴方は、遠野シキという人物を殺してしまったんです。
　彼の帰る場所を、貴方がすべて奪ってしまった。
　遠野槙久によってどこかに幽閉されていたシキが、自分として暮らしていた遠野くんにどんな感情を抱くかはわかりすぎるぐらいです」
「……シキにとって、俺は自分の名前を使って遠野シキになりすましているニセモノなわけか」
「はい。
シキは、何よりも貴方を憎んでいるんだと思います、遠野くん」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“In a sense, you killed the person SHIKI Tohno.
You took away every place to which he might have returned.
Makihisa Tohno imprisoned SHIKI somewhere, and it is painfully easy to imagine what he felt toward the man living his life.”
“To SHIKI, I’m a counterfeit using his name and pretending to be him.”
“Yes. I believe he hates you more than anyone in the world, Tohno.”
lines.mao_english:
“In a sense, you killed the person SHIKI Tohno.
You took away every place to which he might have returned.
Makihisa Tohno imprisoned SHIKI somewhere, and it is painfully easy to imagine what he felt toward the man living his life.”
“To SHIKI, I’m a counterfeit using his name and pretending to be him.”
“Yes. I believe he hates you more than anyone in the world, Tohno.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"In a way----you killed Tohno SHIKI.
You took away his only place to return to.
Being hidden away by Tohno Makihisa while you lived in his place… you can only imagine how SHIKI felt."
"…… To SHIKI, I'm just an impostor who is using the name Tohno SHIKI?"
"Yes, which is why SHIKI hates you more than anything, Tohno-kun."
lines.mirror_moon:
"In a way----you killed Tohno SHIKI.
You took away his only place to return to.
Being hidden away by Tohno Makihisa while you lived in his place… you can only imagine how SHIKI felt."
"…… To SHIKI, I'm just an impostor who is using the name Tohno SHIKI?"
"Yes, which is why SHIKI hates you more than anything, Tohno-kun."

lines.japanese:
そんなの―――こっちだって好きでした事じゃない。
　けれどそんな事はシキにとってどうでもいいのか。
　アイツにとって、俺はすべてを奪った憎むべきニセモノになったんだから。
　自分の居場所を他人に奪われた男。
　その恨み言は増すことはあれ薄れる事もなく、八年間も蓄え続けられた。
　……なるほど、それなら確かにまず俺を殺そうとするだろう。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
It isn’t as though I chose any of that.
But to SHIKI, that hardly matters.
To him, I am the hated counterfeit who stole everything from him.
The man whose rightful place was taken by a stranger.
For eight years, his grievance could only deepen, never fade.
Of course, then, he would try to kill me first.
lines.mao_english:

But to SHIKI, that hardly matters.
To him, I am the hated counterfeit who stole everything from him.
The man whose rightful place was taken by a stranger.
For eight years, his grievance could only deepen, never fade.
Of course, then, he would try to kill me first.
lines.mirrorMoon:
But----I didn't do so because I wanted to.
But I guess SHIKI doesn't care about that.
To him, I'm the hated impostor who stole everything away.
The man who stole his home.
Without any abatement, he lived and seethed in hatred these past eight years.
…… So of course he wants to kill me.

殺されたのは俺のほうなんだ、先輩」
「遠野……くん？」
　そう、奪われたのはこっちだって同じこと。
　八年前っていうコトは九歳のころか。
　その時まで生きていた志貴っていう人間は、綺麗さっぱり消されてしまった。

lines.maoEnglish:
“But listen. I’m still the one who was killed, Ciel.”
“Tohno…?”
Yes—the same thing was taken from me.
Eight years ago, I was nine.
The Shiki who had lived until that day was erased without a trace.

Yes—the same thing was taken from me.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"--But, I was still the one killed, Senpai."
"Tohno…… kun?"
Yeah, I had things stolen from me too.
Eight years ago I was nine years old.
Back then, the Shiki who lived up until that time disappeared without a trace.

lines.japanese:
過去の記憶もよく思い出せない。
　本当の両親に会いたいなんて気はないけど、それでもおそらくは大切であったろう思い出もなくなって。
　ただの志貴という人間は、もうどこにもいなくなってしまっている――――
「遠野くん。
憎しみで戦おうとするのは、いけないコトです」
　……俺の呟きに何か危ういものを感じたのか、先輩はそんな事を言ってくる。
　まさか、と首をふった。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
I can barely remember anything from before.
I have no desire to see my real parents, but even the memories that probably mattered to me once are gone.
The boy who was simply Shiki no longer exists anywhere—
“Tohno. You mustn’t fight out of hatred.”
Perhaps she sensed something dangerous in my muttering and said that.
I shook my head in denial: nothing like that.
lines.mao_english:

I have no desire to see my real parents, but even the memories that probably mattered to me once are gone.
The boy who was simply Shiki no longer exists anywhere—
“Tohno. You mustn’t fight out of hatred.”
Perhaps she sensed something dangerous in my muttering and said that.
I shook my head in denial: nothing like that.
lines.mirrorMoon:
I can't recall my past too well.
I don't have this urge to meet my true parents, but I can't even remember any treasured memories I may have had.
Whoever Shiki had been, he is nowhere to be found----
"Tohno-kun.
You can't fight because of hatred."
…… As if sensing the danger in my words, Senpai warns me.
I tell her not to be ridiculous as I shake my head.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「別にそんなんじゃないよ。
俺がロアをなんとかしようって思うのは別の理由だ」
「憎しみは、ないんですか……？」
「無いといったら嘘になるけど、そんなのはどうでもいい。
ただ、ロアは放っておけない。
ほっとくとお姫さまが一人で無茶をするからな。
　だから助けてやらないと。
最後まで手伝うんだって、あいつと約束したんだから」
―――そうだ。
　だからこんなところで、一人でのうのうと休んでいるワケにはいかない。
　あいつはずっと―――この程度の痛みなんか堪えて、俺に明るい姿を見せてくれてたんだろうから。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“That isn’t why. I have another reason for wanting to stop Roa.”
“You don’t hate him…?”
“I’d be lying if I said I didn’t, but that doesn’t matter. I can’t leave Roa alone. If I do, our princess will go and do something reckless all by herself.
So I have to help her. I promised I’d see this through with her.”
―――That was it.
I couldn’t lie here resting comfortably while she fought alone.
All this time, she must have been bearing pain at least as bad as mine and smiling for me anyway.

“I’d be lying if I said I didn’t, but that doesn’t matter. I can’t leave Roa alone. If I do, our princess will go and do something reckless all by herself.
So I have to help her. I promised I’d see this through with her.”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"That's not it.
I have to deal with Roa for a different reason."
"You don't… hate him……?"
"I'd be lying if I said no, but it doesn't really matter.
I just can't let him run loose by himself, because if I do that, the princess would try too hard.
That's why I have to help her.
I promised her I'd help to the very end."
----That's right.
Which is why I can't be resting here by myself.
She's always----going through so much pain yet tries to act so cheerful in front of me.

lines.maoEnglish:
“Put simply, it’s energy—the force that keeps you alive. Life is infinite, but its immediate reserves are not.
A living body continually produces life force, though the amount it can store varies from person to person.
That means there is a limit to how much can be taken from any one body at a time.
Before we exhaust our reserves, we use what remains to draw fresh life force from the inexhaustible well of life itself.
But if all the stored energy is stolen in an instant, there is nothing left with which to draw out more. Infinite or not, the body then ceases to function.”

She doesn't say anything to me.
She only glares at the enemy in front of her as she breathes painfully.

lines.japanese:
「なんで――――なん、で――――」
　声をあげる事さえ、できなくなる。
　アルクェイドの魔眼とやらのせいじゃない。
　ここまで来たのに。
なにもできない自分が悔しくて、今まで無理やり動かしていた体が、熱を失っていっている。
　そんな俺とアルクェイドを見据えて、ロアは大声で笑い出した。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Why—why—”
Even my voice began to fail.
It wasn’t the work of Arcueid’s Mystic Eyes.
I had come all this way and could do nothing. Rage at my own helplessness drained the warmth from the body I had forced onward for so long.
Roa surveyed the two of us and burst into booming laughter.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Why----why----"
I can't even shout out.
Not because of her Mystic Eyes,
but I've finally made it here.
Cursing my ineffectiveness, my body which I forced for so long starts to lose its heat.
Roa laughs loudly as he watches the two of us.

「―――なるほど、ようやく覚悟を決めたというわけか、姫君！」
　ロアは少しずつアルクェイドへと歩き始める。
　アルクェイドはひざまずいたまま動かない。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“So you’ve finally steeled yourself, Princess!”
Roa advanced on Arcueid, one slow step at a time.
She remained kneeling and did not move.

Roa leisurely walks over to Arcueid.
Arcueid remains kneeled, unmoving.

lines.japanese:
「いやいや、たいしたものだよ志貴。
姫君はおまえを逃がすためにここで私と差しちがえる事にしたらしい。
　だがね、かつての姫君なら恐ろしくもあったが、今の君はただの吸血鬼だ。
真祖としての力もありえない。
　―――まったく。
欲望のままに堕ちていれば良かったものを」
「黙れ！」
　アルクェイドの声が廊下に響く。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Magnificent, Shiki. The Princess means to die with me so that you can escape.
Once, she would have terrified me—but as you are now, you’re no more than a vampire. None of the strength of a True Ancestor remains.
―――What a pity. You should have surrendered to your desires.”
“Silence!”
Arcueid’s voice rang through the corridor.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"My my, you're pretty good, Shiki.
It seems the princess here is going to fight me to save you.
If it were the former princess, you would be terrifying, but you are now just a regular vampire.
You don't even have the power of a True Ancestor anymore.
----Geez, it would have been better if only you fell to your desires."
"Quiet!"
Arcueid's voice echoes through the hallway.

lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:

Unless my eyes were deceiving me, the space around Arcueid had begun to waver.

　歩み寄るロアの足が止まる。
「―――空想具現化か。
まだそれだけの能力があるとは、さすがは真祖の王族」
　じり、と。
　ロアは、恐れで後退した。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ngh—”
Roa’s advance stopped.
“Marble Phantasm. To think you still possess that much power—truly, you are royalty among the True Ancestors.”
Slowly.
Roa retreated in fear.

私にあって君にはないものがあるからだ」

　まるで今の自分の全ての活動を放棄して、力を溜めているような、そんな危うさ。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“But you cannot defeat me. I possess something you do not.”
“…”
Arcueid had stopped breathing.
It was as if she had abandoned every other function of her body to gather strength—a balance so precarious it frightened me.

"------"

lines.japanese:
「わかるだろう？
　そう、それは死の実体験だ。
　私は死を知っているが、君は知らない。
それが私たちの決定的な差だ。
　……まあ、生きているかぎり生物は死を体験できない。
それを知り得るのは転生無限者たる私のみだろうがね」
　……アルクェイドの周囲の揺らぎは、段々と大きくなっていく。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“You understand, don’t you? I have experienced death itself.
I know death, and you do not. That is the decisive difference between us.
No living creature can experience death while it lives, of course. Only I, the Infinite Reincarnator, can know such a thing.”
…The distortion around Arcueid continued to swell.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"You know, don't you?

I know what death is, but you do not.
That is our difference.
…… Well, as long as something is alive, it cannot experience death.
The only one who knows is probably only an infinite reincarnator like me."
…… The wavering of everything around Arcueid grows stronger.

lines.japanese:
「ヒトは未知を本能的に恐れる生物だ。
それは超越者である真祖であろうと変わらない。
いかに神秘を学ぼうと、どれほど長寿の生物がいようと、死を体験することはできない。
　おまえたちは死を拒む事でその強大な力を得るが、同時に弱さをも作り上げた。
　死を避ける君と、死を受け入れた私。
それがアルクェイド・ブリュンスタッドと、ミハイル・ロア・バルダムヨォンの質の違いだ。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Human beings instinctively fear the unknown. Even transcendent beings such as the True Ancestors are no exception. No amount of mystery studied, no span of life endured, can give a living being the experience of death.
You gain your immense power by rejecting death, but in doing so you create your own weakness.
You flee death; I have accepted it. That is the essential difference between Arcueid Brunestud and Michael Roa Valdamjong.
lines.mao_english:

You flee death; I have accepted it. That is the essential difference between Arcueid Brunestud and Michael Roa Valdamjong.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Humans are instinctually afraid of the unknown.
This does not change even for transcendent races like the True Ancestors.
No matter how much of the occult you study, no matter how long-lived you are, you cannot experience death.
You all gain so much power by resisting death, but at the same time it is the source of your weakness.
You run away from death whereas I accept it.
That is the difference in nature between you, Arcueid Brunestud, and I, Michael Roa Valdamjong.

lines.japanese:
「私は今も人として人の時代に生きている。
時代から外れた亡霊にすぎぬ君に、私を罰する権利はない」
　ぱりん、と。
　渡り廊下の窓ガラスが砕けていく。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“I still live as a man within the age of man. You are only a ghost forsaken by the age. You have no right to pass judgment on me.”
A crystalline crash.
The windows along the walkway shattered.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Even now I live as a human in this age.
An out-of-place ghost like yourself has no right to judge me."
Crack.
The glass along the passageway starts to break.

lines.japanese:
「―――私は知っている。
死を。
あの闇を。
何十回とくぐり抜けたあの虚無を―――！
　故に、私にとってこの場の死などただの通過儀礼にすぎぬ。
　仮にこの場でこの肉体が死滅しようと、ロアはまた人の世に孵ってくる。
この場で私と差しちがえるコトは無意味だと、なぜ解らないのだ君は」
　たかだかと両手を広げるロア。
　アルクェイドは答えない。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“I know death—the darkness, the void I have crossed scores of times!
Death here is no more than a rite of passage to me.
Even if this body perishes tonight, Roa will hatch once more into the human world. Why can’t you understand that dying with me here will accomplish nothing?”
Roa flung both arms wide.
Arcueid did not answer.
lines.mao_english:
“I know death—the darkness, the void I have crossed scores of times!
Death here is no more than a rite of passage to me.
Even if this body perishes tonight, Roa will hatch once more into the human world. Why can’t you understand that dying with me here will accomplish nothing?”
Roa flung both arms wide.
Arcueid did not answer.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----I know.
About death.
About the darkness.
The nothingness which I have journeyed through so many times----!
To me, death is little more than a common ritual.
Let's say you destroy this body right here.
I'll still remain in this world.
Why don't you understand it's useless to fight me?"
Roa spreads his arms higher.
Arcueid doesn't answer.

生命力の強い弱いの問題ではなくね。
―――だが。
そういうのを、一般には往生際が悪いというんだぞ」
「……生き汚いのはお互いさまだ。
俺もおまえも、一度は死にぞこなったんだからな」
　その通りだ、とロアはおかしそうに笑う。

……月明かりの下。

「……………」
　ほんとうに、生き汚い。
　倒れこむ一歩手前の体を引きずって、そこへ移動した。
evidence.japaneseHighlight: ほんとうに、生き汚い

…… Under the moonlight.
The courtyard under the passageway has become a sea of rubble.
In its center, something moves.
"………………"
He really is sly when dealing with death.
I pull my almost collapsing body towards it.

lines.japanese:
「死から帰ってきたものは死というものを理解できる。
私とおまえは、その中でもさらに特別な能力があったケースだ。
　私はここに到達するのに十七回もの死を体験してきたが―――おまえはただの一度だけか。
正直、才能の違いだろうな。
もしおまえに転生していたらどれほどの能力になったのか、興味深くはある」
―――余裕に満ちた、耳障りな声。
　聞いているだけで頭が痛む。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Those who return from death gain an understanding of it. You and I are rarer still: our experiences produced extraordinary abilities.
I endured death seventeen times before reaching this point, while one was enough for you. Frankly, it must be a difference in talent. I confess I’m curious what power I might have acquired had I reincarnated into you.”
―――That grating voice, so swollen with confidence.
Just hearing it made my head ache.

"Those returning from the dead can understand death.
You and I are special cases of that kind.

I am really curious what kind of ability it would have been if I had reincarnated in your body."
----A bothersome, overly-composed voice.
Just hearing it makes my head hurt.

殺し返すのは当然だろう？

だというのに、そんな一介の吸血鬼と変わらぬ真祖をとりこんでも意味がない。

lines.maoEnglish:
“The first question is the one that matters.
Why did you kill Arcueid?”
“Why? She intended to kill me. It was only natural that I kill her in return.
“Admittedly, I had no desire for a Princess reduced to that state.
As I am now, I could certainly have dissected her alive. But there was no value in absorbing a True Ancestor no better than an ordinary vampire.
I judged her not worth absorbing and disposed of her instead. I, too, regret that matters ended this way.”
A low chuckle.
The enemy twisted his mouth and laughed.

“I see. Then one more question.

"All you're seeing is life.
You don't understand death at all.
That's why you can't kill me, and you're only able to kill a weakened woman."
My brain reaches a white heat.
"----Wha… t?"

lines.japanese:
「死が視えているのなら、正気でなんかいられない。
おまえに解るのは物を生かしている部分だけなんだよ。
　死が視えるのなら―――とても、立ってなんていられない」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“If you truly saw death, you couldn’t stay sane. All you recognize are the places that keep things alive.
If you saw death—there’s no way you could remain standing.”
lines.mao_english:
“If you truly saw death, you couldn’t stay sane. All you recognize are the places that keep things alive.
If you saw death—there’s no way you could remain standing.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"If you could see death, you couldn't maintain your sanity.
All you can perceive is the part which keeps things alive.
If you could see death----you couldn't even manage to stand."
lines.mirror_moon:
"If you could see death, you couldn't maintain your sanity.
All you can perceive is the part which keeps things alive.
If you could see death----you couldn't even manage to stand."

lines.japanese:
―――例えるのなら、それは月世界。
　なにもかもが死に絶えた荒野に似ている。
　目に見えるものすべてに存る死の綻び。
　触れれば消え去ってしまう世界の事象。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
―――The nearest comparison was a world on the moon.
A wilderness where everything had died.
Every visible thing bore a fatal flaw.
The whole world was made of things that would vanish at a touch.
lines.mao_english:
―――The nearest comparison was a world on the moon.
A wilderness where everything had died.
Every visible thing bore a fatal flaw.
The whole world was made of things that would vanish at a touch.
lines.mirrorMoon:
----To give an example, it is the world on the moon.
Everything is like a desolate wasteland.
The seam of death on everything I see.
Events of the world which disappear when I touch them.
lines.mirror_moon:
----To give an example, it is the world on the moon.
Everything is like a desolate wasteland.
The seam of death on everything I see.
Events of the world which disappear when I touch them.

lines.japanese:
「おまえ―――なにを」
「……物事の『死』が視えるという事は、この世界すべてがあやふやで脆いという事実に投げ込まれることだ。
　地面なんて無いに等しいし、空なんて今にも落ちてきそう」
「なにを―――何の事を言っているんだ、おまえ」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“You… what are you—?”
“To see the ‘death’ of things is to be cast into the knowledge that everything in this world is uncertain and fragile.
The ground may as well not exist. The sky looks ready to fall at any moment.”
“What are you talking about? What does any of that mean?”
lines.mao_english:
“You… what are you—?”
“To see the ‘death’ of things is to be cast into the knowledge that everything in this world is uncertain and fragile.
The ground may as well not exist. The sky looks ready to fall at any moment.”
“What are you talking about? What does any of that mean?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"What----are you……"
"…… Being able to see the 'death' of things means you are forced to see the world's uncertainty and fragility.
The ground is like it's not there, and the sky seems about to fall at any moment."
"What are----what are you talking about?"
lines.mirror_moon:
"What----are you……"
"…… Being able to see the 'death' of things means you are forced to see the world's uncertainty and fragility.
The ground is like it's not there, and the sky seems about to fall at any moment."
"What are----what are you talking about?"

lines.japanese:
ロアの声が、動揺している。
　……それはそうだろう。
　だって、俺が言っていることを、あいつは一ミリだって理解できない。
　それはつまり―――ヤツと俺の目は、よく似ているだけでまったくの別物だという事だから。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
Roa’s voice had begun to shake.
Of course it had.
He could not understand even a fraction of what I was saying.
That proved it: his eyes and mine only resembled each other. In truth, they were entirely different things.
lines.mao_english:
Roa’s voice had begun to shake.
Of course it had.
He could not understand even a fraction of what I was saying.
That proved it: his eyes and mine only resembled each other. In truth, they were entirely different things.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Roa's voice falters.
…… Of course.
Because he can't even understand the slightest bit of what I'm saying.
In other words----his eyes and mine may be similar, but they're completely different things.
lines.mirror_moon:
Roa's voice falters.
…… Of course.
Because he can't even understand the slightest bit of what I'm saying.
In other words----his eyes and mine may be similar, but they're completely different things.

lines.japanese:
「―――やめろ。
その目で―――その目で私を見るな」
　ロアの声に恐れが交じる。
　いみじくもヤツ自身が言っていた。
　ヒトは、未知なるものを本能的に恐れる生き物だって。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Stop. Don’t look at me with those eyes!”
Fear entered Roa’s voice.
He had said it himself.
Human beings instinctively fear the unknown.
lines.mao_english:
“Stop. Don’t look at me with those eyes!”
Fear entered Roa’s voice.
He had said it himself.
Human beings instinctively fear the unknown.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Stop it.
Those eyes----don't look at me with those eyes."
Fear mixes into Roa's voice.
He even said it himself.
Humans are instinctually afraid of the unknown.
lines.mirror_moon:
"----Stop it.
Those eyes----don't look at me with those eyes."
Fear mixes into Roa's voice.
He even said it himself.
Humans are instinctually afraid of the unknown.

lines.japanese:
「……一秒先にも世界すべてが死んでしまいそうな錯覚を、おまえは知らない。
―――それが、死を視るという事なんだ。
　この目はさ、おまえみたいに得意げに語れる力なんかじゃない」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“You don’t know the illusion that the whole world might die one second from now.
―――That is what it means to see death.
These eyes aren’t some wonderful power I could ever boast of, the way you do.”
lines.mao_english:
“You don’t know the illusion that the whole world might die one second from now.
―――That is what it means to see death.
These eyes aren’t some wonderful power I could ever boast of, the way you do.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… You don't know of the illusion that the whole world could perish in an instant.
----That is what it means to see death.
These eyes, this power isn't something you can boast about like you did."
lines.mirror_moon:
"…… You don't know of the illusion that the whole world could perish in an instant.
----That is what it means to see death.
These eyes, this power isn't something you can boast about like you did."

lines.japanese:
そう、歩くことさえ、恐ろしかったあの頃。
　俺だって―――あの人に出会っていなければ、とうの昔にどうかしていた。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
Back then, even taking a step had terrified me.
If I had never met that person, I would have lost my mind long ago.
lines.mao_english:
Back then, even taking a step had terrified me.
If I had never met that person, I would have lost my mind long ago.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Yeah, back then, I was even scared of walking.
Even I would----If I hadn't met that person, I would have long since been insane.
lines.mirror_moon:
Yeah, back then, I was even scared of walking.
Even I would----If I hadn't met that person, I would have long since been insane.

lines.japanese:
「それがおまえの勘違いだ、吸血鬼。
　命と死は背中合わせでいるだけで、永遠に、顔を合わせることはないものだろ」
「だから―――その目で私を見るなと言っているだろう……！」
　走ってくる足音。
　けど、俺のほうが何倍も早い。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“That’s where you’re mistaken, vampire.
Life and death stand back to back. They can never, for all eternity, look each other in the face.”
“I told you—stop looking at me with those eyes!”
His footsteps rushed toward me.
But I was many times faster.
lines.mao_english:
“That’s where you’re mistaken, vampire.
Life and death stand back to back. They can never, for all eternity, look each other in the face.”
“I told you—stop looking at me with those eyes!”
His footsteps rushed toward me.
But I was many times faster.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"That's your mistake, vampire.
Life and death may be back to back, but they will never face each other."
"I'm telling you----don't look at me with those eyes……!"
The sound of running footsteps.
But, I'm many times faster.
lines.mirror_moon:
"That's your mistake, vampire.
Life and death may be back to back, but they will never face each other."
"I'm telling you----don't look at me with those eyes……!"
The sound of running footsteps.
But, I'm many times faster.

lines.japanese:
「―――教えてやる。
　これが、モノを殺すっていうことだ」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“I’ll teach you.
This is what it means to kill something.”
lines.mao_english:
“I’ll teach you.
This is what it means to kill something.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----I'll show you.
This is what it means to kill something."
lines.mirror_moon:
"----I'll show you.
This is what it means to kill something."

lines.japanese:
告げて。
　たん、と廊下の『点』を突き刺した。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
Having said it.
I drove the knife into the corridor’s “point.”
lines.mao_english:
Having said it.
I drove the knife into the corridor’s “point.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
Saying that,
I thrust through the hallway's "point" on the floor.
lines.mirror_moon:
Saying that,
I thrust through the hallway's "point" on the floor.

lines.japanese:
瞬間――――渡り廊下に張り巡らされていた線が、瞬時にうねる。
「な―――――！」
　ロアの叫び声も、崩れていくガレキの音にかき消される。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
In that instant, every line veining the walkway writhed.
“What—!”
Roa’s cry vanished beneath the roar of collapsing debris.
lines.mao_english:
In that instant, every line veining the walkway writhed.
“What—!”
Roa’s cry vanished beneath the roar of collapsing debris.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Instantaneously----the lines racing through the passageway undulate.
"Wha------!"
Even the sound of Roa's screaming voice is buried amidst the crashing rubble.
lines.mirror_moon:
Instantaneously----the lines racing through the passageway undulate.
"Wha------!"
Even the sound of Roa's screaming voice is buried amidst the crashing rubble.

lines.japanese:
渡り廊下は、文字通り殺された。
　意味をなくした塊は、瞬時に瓦解して崩れ去っていく。
　ロアにとってみれば、完全な不意打ちだったのか。
　廊下の崩壊にまきこまれ、瓦礫に潰されながら、ロアは地上へと落下していった。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
The walkway had quite literally been killed.
Reduced to a mass without meaning, it disintegrated and fell apart in an instant.
For Roa, it must have been a complete surprise.
Caught in the collapse and crushed beneath the rubble, he plunged toward the ground below.
lines.mao_english:
The walkway had quite literally been killed.
Reduced to a mass without meaning, it disintegrated and fell apart in an instant.
For Roa, it must have been a complete surprise.
Caught in the collapse and crushed beneath the rubble, he plunged toward the ground below.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The passageway is literally killed.
The blocks which lost their meaning break apart and crumble away.
For Roa, it must have been a total surprise attack.
Pulled down by the destruction of the hallway and the collapsing rubble, Roa falls to the earth.

lines.japanese:
「……………」
　目の前からすべて、渡り廊下は崩れ落ちた。
　痛む頭と、硝る体をこらえて、階段に向かう。
「……………」
　アルクェイドの亡骸を通りすぎて、中庭に急いだ。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“…”
The entire walkway had fallen away before me.
Enduring the agony in my head and my failing body, I turned toward the stairs.
“…”
I passed Arcueid’s remains and hurried down to the courtyard.
lines.mao_english:
“…”

Enduring the agony in my head and my failing body, I turned toward the stairs.
“…”
I passed Arcueid’s remains and hurried down to the courtyard.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"………………"
In front of my very eyes, the passageway crumbles away.
Enduring the pain in my head and the burning in my body, I head to the stairs.
"……………"
I head past Arcueid's corpse and hurry to the courtyard.
lines.mirror_moon:
"………………"

Enduring the pain in my head and the burning in my body, I head to the stairs.

lines.japanese:
……月明かりの下。
　渡り廊下のあった中庭は、一面の瓦礫の海と化していた。
　その中心に、ガラガラと動くモノがある。
「……………」
　ほんとうに、生き汚い。
　倒れこむ一歩手前の体を引きずって、そこへ移動した。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
Beneath the moonlight.
The courtyard where the walkway had stood was now a sea of rubble.
Something shifted and rattled at its center.
“…”
He truly did not know when to die.
Dragging a body on the verge of collapse, I made my way toward him.
lines.mao_english:
Beneath the moonlight.
The courtyard where the walkway had stood was now a sea of rubble.
Something shifted and rattled at its center.
“…”
He truly did not know when to die.
Dragging a body on the verge of collapse, I made my way toward him.
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… Under the moonlight.
The courtyard under the passageway has become a sea of rubble.
In its center, something moves.
"………………"
He really is sly when dealing with death.
I pull my almost collapsing body towards it.

evidence.japanese:
「死が視える人間というのは死から逃れる術に長けているらしい。
生命力の強い弱いの問題ではなくね。
―――だが。
そういうのを、一般には往生際が悪いというんだぞ」
「……生き汚いのはお互いさまだ。
俺もおまえも、一度は死にぞこなったんだからな」
　その通りだ、とロアはおかしそうに笑う。
evidence.japaneseHighlight: 往生際が悪い
evidence.label: s199
evidence.mirrorMoon:
"It seems those who can see death are good at escaping death.
It isn't a matter of the strength or weakness of your life.
----However.
Normally, people call that useless effort."
"…… You're one to talk.
You and I, we've already died once."
"Exactly," Roa says as he smiles.
evidence.mirrorMoonHighlight: people call that useless effort

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Roa first calls Shiki someone who refuses to accept death gracefully; Shiki answers that both of them cling shamelessly to life. When the bisected Roa crawls back, Shiki repeats that he truly is 生き汚い. mirror moon substitutes 'useless effort,' 'you're one to talk,' and then 'sly when dealing with death,' erasing both the shared accusation and its callback.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: The repeated language of clinging disgracefully to life disappears twice

lines.japanese:
……たいしたものだ。
　ロアの下半身は、まるで存在していない。
　だというのに瓦礫から這い出てきたロアの上半身は、そんな事とか無関係に活動している。
　その生命力には、純粋に敬意を表するべきかもしれない。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
It was almost impressive.
Roa’s lower body had ceased to exist.
Yet his upper half crawled from the rubble and continued functioning as though that were irrelevant.
His life force might almost have deserved my sincere respect.
lines.mao_english:
It was almost impressive.

Yet his upper half crawled from the rubble and continued functioning as though that were irrelevant.
His life force might almost have deserved my sincere respect.
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… He's really something.
The lower half of Roa's body is almost completely gone.
Yet coming out from underneath the rubble, the upper half of his body still moves, ignoring that fact.
This amount of life may almost be something worthy of respect.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「―――なんだ、今のは」
　震えながら、ロアはそんなことを呟く。
　瓦礫の上を歩いて、ロアの目の前へと歩いていく。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“What… was that?”
Roa whispered, trembling.
I picked my way over the rubble until I stood before him.
lines.mao_english:
“What… was that?”

I picked my way over the rubble until I stood before him.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----What, was that?"
Quivering, Roa wonders aloud.
Walking on top of the rubble, I move directly in front of him.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「―――志貴」
　ロアは顔をあげてこちらを見上げてくる。
　その目には、眼球から溢れ出しそうなほど、憎しみが満ちていた。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“Shiki…”
Roa raised his face toward me.
His eyes held so much hatred it seemed ready to spill from their sockets.
lines.mao_english:
“Shiki…”
Roa raised his face toward me.
His eyes held so much hatred it seemed ready to spill from their sockets.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Shiki."
Roa lifts his head to look at me.
His eyes seem to practically ooze with hatred.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「―――化け物、め」
　憎々しげな怨嗟の声。
「どっちが」
　返答して、ロアの前に立った。
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:
“You… monster.”
The words were thick with loathing.
“Look who’s talking.”
I stopped in front of him.
lines.mao_english:
“You… monster.”
The words were thick with loathing.
“Look who’s talking.”
I stopped in front of him.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----You, monster."
His voice equally full of indignant hatred.
"Who is?"
Replying, I stand in front of him.
lines.mirror_moon:
"----You, monster."

lines.japanese:
ロアの『死』は心臓のやや右よりにある。
　ナイフでとん、と突き刺す。
　紙を貫くような感覚。
その感触こそが『死』だ。
　あ
　、とロアは短い声をあげた。
　……彼も死を体験してきた男だ。
その感触をよく知っているんだろう。
「……恐ろしくはないだろう？
　おまえにとっては馴染んだ道だ。
違うところがあるとすれば、それは一つだけ」
lines.label: s199
lines.maoEnglish:

I gave the knife a light push.
It passed through with the feeling of piercing paper. That sensation was “death.”
“Ah…”
The brief sound escaped Roa.
…He, too, had experienced death. He must have known that sensation well.
“It isn’t frightening, is it? You’ve traveled this road many times before. There is only one difference.”

ナイフを抜いて、ロアに背を向けた。

lines.maoEnglish:
I pulled out the knife and turned my back on him.
Roa had not yet completed his death.
Like Arcueid, he had lived so long that the process took a little more time.
“Hah—ah.”
My consciousness dimmed.
If my body was at its limit, my mind had passed beyond it.
Arcueid had mentioned it.
Don’t force yourself to see the death of minerals. Something about the blood vessels in your brain burning out.
